[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[!exec:sh] skip 'needs sh to check exit status'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
cd app

logos conc run . ok
! stderr .

exec sh ../status.sh 7 logos conc run . exit7
stderr '^exit status 7$'
! stderr 'conc::'

exec sh ../status.sh 7 logos conc run . finding exit7
stderr '\[conc::lock_order_inversion\]'
stderr '^exit status 7$'

exec sh ../status.sh 1 logos conc run . finding ok
stderr '\[conc::lock_order_inversion\]'
! stderr '^exit status'

exec sh ../status.sh 137 logos conc run . signal
stderr '^signal: killed$'

exec sh ../status.sh 1 logos run . exit7
stderr '^exit status 7$'
exec sh ../status.sh 1 go run ../plain.go
stderr '^exit status 7$'

# Use the script's logos for the nested run, before run prepends GOROOT/bin.
exec sh -c 'tool=$(command -v logos) || exit 1; exec "$tool" conc run . nested "$tool"'
stderr '^exit status 7$'

-- status.sh --
want=$1
shift
"$@"
status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne "$want" ]; then
	printf 'exit code %s, want %s\n' "$status" "$want" >&2
	exit 1
fi
-- plain.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(7) }
-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/exit

go 1.27
-- app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"

	"logos/sync"
)

var left, right sync.Locked[int]

func forward() error {
	left.WithLock(func(*int) {
		right.WithLock(func(*int) {})
	})
	return nil
}

func invert(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go forward()
	}
	right.WithLock(func(*int) {
		left.WithLock(func(*int) {})
	})
	return nil
}

func main() {
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "ok":
		return
	case "exit7":
		os.Exit(7)
	case "finding":
		if err := invert(context.Background()); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if os.Args[2] == "exit7" {
			os.Exit(7)
		}
	case "signal":
		if err := syscall.Kill(os.Getpid(), syscall.SIGKILL); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	case "nested":
		runNested(os.Args[2])
	}
}

func runNested(logos string) {
	cmd := exec.Command(logos, "run", ".", "exit7")
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		if exit, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok && exit.ExitCode() == 1 {
			return
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	}
	os.Exit(3)
}
